dex.entry: A broad, slow-moving tortoise whose domed shell is encrusted with genuine crystal growths from the mine, each facet catching the lamp-light differently. Canon Cinderhead Mine resident. The iconic crystal-shelled tortoise of Cinderhead Mine; seeing it lumbering through the cave is an awe moment.

art.silhouette: Massive hexagonal-plated shell studded with diamond-crystal spires; four column-thick legs; small blunt head with half-lidded stone-grey eyes; walks with serene deliberateness; silhouette unmistakable at any size.
